rules.new_licensee_rule: Veterinarians licensed in their year of graduation need no CE for the next renewal.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses presented or approved by AVMA, AAHA, NCVMA, USDA-APHIS, AAVSB RACE, or academies/schools/colleges of veterinary medicine; other courses with prior Board approval
rules.audit_note: Keep a file of course content for the three most recent renewal periods.
rules.notes: 20 hours per calendar-year license period; max 10 hours self-study, prerecorded webinars or non-interactive online. Live interactive webinars count as in-person. Proposed amendment (hearing 10/7/2026, proposed effective 1/1/2027) would add 1 hour of opioid training — not yet in force.
rules.rule_quote: A veterinarian shall earn 20 continuing education credit hours for the calendar year license renewal period.
